cohort: The study included 53,586 singleton term births, categorized into appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA), large for gestational age (LGA), and macrosomic deliveries.
finding: The definition of macrosomia as >4000 g performed poorer than other classifiers in predicting adverse perinatal outcomes, while LGA >90th centile performed comparably to other macrosomia definitions.
cross-section timing: At the time of singleton term birth and the immediate perinatal period.
birth_weight: Birth weights defining macrosomia (>4000 g, >4250 g, >4500 g) and large for gestational age (>90th centile) were central to the study.
gest_age: The study focused on singleton term births.
